kamloops.title: Tom Dyas re-elected mayor of Kelowna
kamloops.description: Dyas ran a campaign focused on public safety when he won the top job in 2022, in what was his first elected government role. He held off the challenge of Ron Cannan, a former councillor and MP for the area.

kamloops.title: Kamloops voters choose former councillor Mike O’Reilly as mayor
kamloops.description: Voters in Kamloops, B.C., have chosen a familiar face to lead council in the next four years, electing two-term councillor Mike O'Reilly.

prince-george.title: Prince George voters choose former councillor Garth Frizzell as mayor
prince-george.description: After a tight race between nine candidates, including an incumbent mayor and two former city councillors, Prince George voters have chosen former councillor Garth Frizzell to lead the city.
